cases.obligation: An authorized reversible effect is independently observed and restored exactly.
Concurrent workers sharing one idempotency key create one effect and one duplicate rejection.
A cached credential from a revoked epoch cannot create an effect.
Recovery discovers and removes an effect left by a worker crash before ledger acknowledgement.
An append-only effect is compensated and retained as an explicit irreversible history residual.
Nine declared state classes restore byte-exactly from a checkpoint selected before mutation.
Primary, cache, backup, derived, and descendant storage copies are removed while behavioral, influence, and privacy claims remain separate.
A valid credential cannot write outside its exact case-bound effect scope.

non_claims: The cases use a contained local filesystem and SQLite ledger, not a deployed AI service or open network.
The state payloads are deterministic bytes, not trained model, optimizer, scheduler, or production cache state.
Local observation and deletion do not establish complete external-effect discovery, causal influence removal, privacy repair, legal compliance, or storage erasure outside the sandbox.
Passing cases do not establish usefulness, production safety, transfer, SOTA, AGI, ASI, support promotion, or release authority.
